environment.description: ECS Fargate cluster with Istio service mesh. PeerAuthentication resource enforces STRICT mTLS cluster-wide. An AuthorizationPolicy is applied to the workloads namespace with a single rule: source principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/admin/sa/admin-service-account' are allowed on paths ['/api/v1/process'] with method POST when request headers contain 'x-mesh-context-type' NOT matching 'admin'. A second AuthorizationPolicy with DENY action is applied at mesh level (rootNamespace: istio-system) that explicitly denies any request where source namespace is NOT 'admin' AND the request body would be inspected via an EnvoyFilter ExtAuthz callout to an OPA sidecar that validates the 'type' field in JSON payloads against the source namespace's allowed-types ConfigMap. The OPA policy (rego) maps namespace 'tenant-apps' to allowed types ['user'] only. Additionally, a Sidecar resource restricts egress from tenant-apps namespace to only reach services in tenant-apps namespace (not workloads).

config.cluster: ECS Fargate with EKS control plane

sidecar_resource.note: restricts service discovery and egress to same namespace only

config.network_policies: Calico CNI policy denying tenant-apps -> workloads at L3
